title: Kenyan Grilled Chicken Salad
community: Urban Kenya — the healthy café option
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Grilled Chicken Salad — spiced grilled chicken strips over mixed greens with sliced mango, avocado, cherry tomatoes, and a passion fruit vinaigrette. The healthy option on every Nairobi café menu — made extraordinary by the quality of Kenya's tropical ingredients.
longDesc: The Kenyan grilled chicken salad has its own identity — the tropical fruit, the avocado, and above all the passion fruit vinaigrette make it something that no imported salad concept can match. The passion fruit vinaigrette is tart, sweet, and fragrant in a way that simple lemon vinaigrette is not.
steps: Season chicken with curry powder, paprika, and salt.
Grill over medium-high heat for 5—6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Make vinaigrette: whisk passion fruit juice, olive oil, honey, lemon, and salt.
Top with mango, avocado, tomatoes, and onion.
chefTips: Let the chicken rest before slicing — it stays juicier.
The passion fruit vinaigrette is the star — make extra.
Dress the salad immediately before serving.
cookingScience: Passion fruit juice's complex acidity (citric, malic, and tartaric acids) creates a vinaigrette with greater depth than lemon alone. The honey emulsifies partially with the olive oil, creating a more cohesive dressing.
sustainabilityTips: Kenya-grown mango, avocado, and passion fruit make this the most locally sourced salad on the menu.
healthBenefits: Mango and passion fruit provide vitamins A and C.
culturalNote: The Kenyan grilled chicken salad demonstrates that healthy café food can celebrate rather than apologise for local ingredients — the passion fruit vinaigrette and tropical fruit make this salad something genuinely distinctive.
